creator: Alexander Terp
description:
Panes are named by Muster and addressable from anywhere; tabs still carry the backend's id, which means nothing on another machine. So `muster window` names a tab by its place and its label and gives no id, and there is no way to focus or rename a tab from a script except through a pane in it.

The same argument that produced pane names applies: mint a tab name, bind it to the backend's id, put it in the schema. Smaller stakes than a pane, because nothing has to tell a tab which tab it is - so this is about addressing rather than about identity.

Documented in `docs/cli/limits.md`.
title: 🏷️ A tab has no name anybody outside Muster can say
